title: Update ObjectQL components to support all v3.0.1 field types
body:
The ObjectForm and ObjectTable components only supported a subset of ObjectQL field types, missing newly added types like `markdown`, `html`, `time`, `phone`, `image`, `file`, `location`, `formula`, `summary`, `auto_number`, `object`, `vector`, and `grid`.

## Changes

**ObjectForm**
- Added mappings for all 27 field types from @objectql/types v3.0.1
- Auto-set computed fields (`formula`, `summary`, `auto_number`) to read-only
- Added `inputType` attributes for `email`, `phone`, `url`, `password`, `time`
- Fixed property mappings: `maxLength` → `max_length`, `minLength` → `min_length`
- Added file size formatting helper with validation for `file`/`image` fields

**ObjectTable**
- Added type-aware column configuration (`date`, `boolean`, `number`)
- Custom cell renderers for `file`/`image` fields showing count with proper pluralization
- Custom cell renderers for `lookup`/`master_detail` fields with safe object fallback

## Example

```typescript
// ObjectForm now properly handles all field types
const schema: ObjectFormSchema = {
  type: 'object-form',
  objectName: 'documents',
  mode: 'create',
  fields: ['title', 'content', 'attachments', 'status']
  // Automatically maps:
  // - 'title' (text) → input
  // - 'content' (markdown) → textarea  
  // - 'attachments' (file, multiple) → file-upload with accept handling
  // - 'status' (formula) → input (read-only)
};
```
